scientific_question: Does a conformal build-pool budget selected on an old graph snapshot retain risk and cost performance after equal-size delete/insert refresh followed by rebuild?
refresh_semantics: For each fraction, delete a seeded subset of the original 100K base and insert the same number of previously excluded vectors; rebuild at fixed size. Query, base, and insertion identities are disjoint.
query_firewall: The frozen HDF5 train rows used as new queries are excluded from all base/insert sets. Evaluation rows cannot change grid, thresholds, methods, or stopping rules.

endpoint.bottom: minimum registered ef reaching success; BOT if none
endpoint.BOT_handling: positive infinity; an infinite conformal selection abstains to ef=200 and is reported

conformal.note: Rank ceil((1-alpha)*(k+1)) over nine source builds; the tenth build is held out. The refreshed-snapshot method is explicitly non-deployable and quantifies attainable within-snapshot recovery.

statistics.bootstrap: target-build outer, query inner, 5000 repetitions, seed 991

strict_gate.safety: Both datasets at every refresh fraction: point risk <= 0.10 and target-build-cluster 95% upper bound <= 0.10 for OLD_SNAPSHOT_K9_CONFORMAL.
strict_gate.tail: Selected-ef p95 is no worse than FIXED_EF_200 and no worse than 10% above the refreshed-snapshot conformal upper bound.
strict_gate.robustness: Direction survives LOBO and deletion of the largest-contribution build.
strict_gate.transfer: Old-snapshot conformal risk is non-inferior to refreshed-snapshot conformal risk by at most 0.02 absolute.

stop_rules: Run a SIFT 1%-refresh one-build smoke before the matrix.
Stop on identity overlap, non-replay, metric mismatch, or storage free space below projected additions plus 5 GiB.
Do not reinterpret old formal-test, validation-dev, certification-reserved, or evaluation-reserved artifacts.
Do not tune after viewing results.
